# .vscode/

Editor configuration shared across contributors via the repo, not personal settings.

## Files

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `settings.json` | Workspace settings (formatter, editor behaviour) |
| `extensions.json` | Recommended extensions VS Code prompts new contributors to install |
| `anim.code-snippets` | Snippet shortcuts for Framer Motion animation variants used across `components/sections/*.tsx` |
